title: Sound Pitch Expansion
description: Expand the sound pitch range for in-game audio.
body:
## What is this MOD?
It expands the pitch range of in-game audio.


Installing this MOD allows audio to be played within a range of 0x to 16x.

*Normally, audio can be played within a range of 0.5x to 2x*

## Important Notice
**This MOD uses Mixin. Please be aware that it may cause instability.**

Note: When using the game's standard `/playsound` command, the range is limited to 0x to 2x.
## Try It Out
`/playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @s ~ ~ ~ 1 0.25`: Plays at 0.25x pitch
